learning_outcomes.text: Applies fundamental laws of mass and energy conservation to the drying process.
Calculates heat and mass transfer in the drying process.
Reads and uses thermodynamic tables and diagrams.
Designs a dryer for a product.
Classifies and compares classical drying methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Drying Techniques: Basic Concepts
Fundamental Laws: Mass Conservation, Energy Conservation, Ideal Gas Equation and Related Relations and Tables
Heat and Mass Transfer in Drying Techniques
Heat and Mass Transfer in Drying Techniques
Heat and Mass Transfer in Drying Techniques: Sample Applications
Basic Drying Processes and Mass-Energy Conservation Equations
Static Calculation (at Equilibrium State) of the Drying Process
Classification of Dried Products, Drying Characteristics, Product Moisture
Sorption Isotherms and Drying Rate Diagrams
